text: Ironvale Athletic quickly moves the ball forward from a free kick near their own half on the right side. Teo Quinlan passes to Jonah Lindqvist, who plays the ball short to Oskar Lindgren. Lindgren sends a through pass toward the centre left area about 12 metres from the Redmond Rovers’ goal at the left end. Jonah Lindqvist runs onto the ball and shoots from close in, about 4.6 metres from goal, scoring to give Ironvale Athletic the lead, 1-2 [#1153] [#1154] [#1155] [#1156] [#1157].
